name: cmd-r-runs-the-ring-in-the-favicon-colour
description: A reload from the keyboard never clicked a row, so the click-driven mark never ran. The ring now follows the browser's DidStartLoading and DidStopLoading, and it takes the favicon's colour. The fixture is the dark page with a solid red icon: a watcher on the selected row records whether the loading class came and went across a Cmd+R, and the row's ring colour reads red.

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.row.sel'); if (!r) { return 'no selected row'; } const m = /rgb\((\d+) (\d+) (\d+)\)/.exec(r.style.getPropertyValue('--ringb')); if (!m) { return 'tint mix: ' + r.style.getPropertyValue('--ringb'); } const [r1, g1, b1] = m.slice(1).map(Number); return (r1 > 150 && g1 < 60 && b1 < 60) ? 'red' : 'rgb ' + m.slice(1).join(' '); })()

(() => { window.__ringSeen = 'not yet'; if (!document.querySelector('.row.sel')) { return 'no selected row'; } const mo = new MutationObserver(() => { const lit = document.querySelector('.row.sel.loading'); if (lit) { window.__ringSeen = 'seen'; } else if (window.__ringSeen === 'seen') { window.__ringSeen = 'seen then cleared'; } }); mo.observe(document.body, {subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class']}); return 'armed'; })()

assertions.desc: the watcher sat on the selected row before the chord
THE MEASUREMENT: the loading class arrived with the browser's start and left with its stop. 'not yet' is the old build, where a keyboard reload marked nothing.
the ring carries the icon's red, not the tint mix
